subject.title: feat(workboard): add durable status_changed notification event

question: Should Workboard expose `status_changed` as a supported durable subscription contract, including its transition payload and stable replay semantics, rather than keep status movement available only through card reads and existing terminal notifications?
rationale: The patch is a coherent implementation, but accepting a new durable event kind determines a long-lived consumer-facing API and message-delivery expectation that cannot be settled from tests alone.

options.title: Sponsor the durable event contract
options.body: Approve `status_changed` as a strict opt-in Workboard subscription event and merge after exact-head CI is green.

options.title: Keep Workboard notifications terminal-only
options.body: Decline the new durable event contract and retain status movement as card-state data rather than a notification stream.

options.title: Narrow the public contract first
options.body: Ask for a maintainer-defined payload or compatibility boundary before accepting durable downstream use.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the durable event contract
recommendation.body: Approve `status_changed` as a strict opt-in Workboard subscription event and merge after exact-head CI is green.
